stem:
阅读短文，判断正误：
Healthy food helps us grow strong. For breakfast, Amy has an egg, some bread and a glass of milk. For lunch, she eats rice, chicken and fresh vegetables. She does not eat too much candy.
判断：关于「Why does Amy avoid eating too much candy?」，答案是「Because she wants to eat healthy food」。
solution: 首句点明 Healthy food helps us grow strong。 因此该判断正确。

stem: 自然拼读判断：单词「mule」和「sun」在「u-e 相对开音节」位置的发音相同。
solution: 「mule」发 u-e 发 /juː/，而「sun」发音不同，故错误。

explanation.steps: 【标准讲解】「mule」发 u-e 发 /juː/，而「sun」发音不同，故错误。 参考答案：错误（× / F）。
explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】切勿仅凭字母拼写外观猜测，要结合自然拼读规律大声拼读验证发音是否一致。
